Disabling capture_svg still produces content; SVG is not extracted as an image

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<p>Below SVG:</p><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="10" height="10"><rect width="10" height="10" fill="red"/></svg>', HtmlToMarkdownRs::ConversionOptions.new(capture_svg: false, extract_images: true))
puts result.inspect
```
